title: Degree-plan extraction (v1.0)
description: Canonical output of the LLM extraction step for one Acalog catalog program (poid) page, loading Module 6 (docs/schema_v2.dbml; GAP_ANALYSIS Q1/Q2). Requirements are versioned by catalog edition (ADR-007) — every fulfillment answer cites its edition. Never invent values: if the page doesn't state a credit count or rule, use null; raw_text on requisites always keeps the verbatim sentence.

poid.description: Acalog program id from the page URL

name.description: Program name as the catalog states it

award_type.description: AA | AS | AAS | certificate | core_curriculum | bachelor awards (BAS/BAT) — as stated; null if unstated

group_name.description: Requirement group as the catalog states it, e.g. 'American History (060)', 'Major Courses'

component_area_code.description: TX core Foundational Component Area code 010–090 when applicable

rule.description: Free-text rule when not simply 'take N credits from list' — never force prose into numbers

requisites.description: Typed requisite edges stated on the page (course_requisites rows)

requisite_course.description: The course this edge points at; null when the requisite is not a course (e.g. TSI Reading)

raw_text.description: Verbatim requisite sentence — ALWAYS kept; structure is added, never substituted
